The player can lose items if they collapse due to low health in
. In that case they can speak to

in the Adventurer's Guild to use the "Item Recovery Service", which will recover one of the lost items for a fee. The fee is equivalent to the sell price of the item or stack - recovering a non-saleable item is free. The item will be mailed to the player overnight. Only one item (or one stack) can be recovered; the rest are lost permanently after it's selected. The player can make their choice anytime until their next collapse due to low health, which will reset it to the new lost items.
